draft_notes.explanation: Identify an isolated filled rectangle whose stripes have distinct colours and whose colour set strictly contains all remaining ink colours. Require exactly one candidate; never select longest/first. Infer the relative legend/stack direction from demonstration outputs, then recreate all translated copies and erase the legend. The factory ignores d4; source operates entirely in visible coordinates. Query output is never accessed.
draft_notes.limitations: The one-visible-copy spacing rule requires the sprite to occupy its full extent along the stack direction. This is guaranteed for native random draws: common.diagonally_connected_sprite uses conway_sprite, which starts with every pixel and forbids deleting the final pixel in any row or column. Separate shuffle of rows and columns retains those marginals. Canonical explicit fixture patterns also occupy every row. Arbitrary caller-supplied patterns with hidden blank edge rows are outside this identifiable constructor subset; no native random domains or constructor code were narrowed. The expected background remains a palette constant.
draft_notes.evidence_gate: Independent scan-line maximal-run enumeration and coordinate-set rendering in arc_agi2.legend_stack_evidence.require_legend_stack_evidence. Generated source instead uses 4-neighbour component enumeration and NumPy grids. Both require one legend, complete consecutive shown colour interval, equal translated masks, demo-consistent stack direction, and a unique query prediction.
